verdict.rationale: A tax authority can reasonably be expected to publish its third-party authorization rules, including power-of-attorney forms, representative roles and which signatures must stay personal, so this question applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes, both showing HTTP 403 edge denials on the front-door site and the MyFTB/Web Pay host. Nothing in it documents authorization forms, delegate roles or signature limits, so the capability is unevidenced rather than not applicable.
